meta.why: Reads the real viewer chat off a YouTube live broadcast and hands normalized messages to W2. Official liveChatMessages API — no scraping, no ToS risk on the self-test (plan 04). Build FIRST: YouTube is the M2 self-test platform.
meta.setup: 1) Set CONFIG.maya_api to the maya-server URL and CONFIG.w2_webhook to W2's production URL. 2) Attach a YouTube OAuth2 credential to both HTTP nodes. 3) Start the broadcast, then run 'Find active broadcast' once — it caches liveChatId in workflow static data. 4) Activate.
meta.polling: 5s. The API quota is per-call, not per-message: 5s is the documented sweet spot for a live chat that must feel answered within ~8s end to end (GATE 2).
